entities.summary: Perlan is a nature discovery destination in Reykjavík, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A polished, highly experiential Iceland-nature attraction with an indoor ice cave, planetarium and strong geological interpretation. This entry is intended for 6–adult travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A polished, highly experiential Iceland-nature attraction with an indoor ice cave, planetarium and strong geological interpretation.
